name: WMPG Portland MP3 WAV Download Link Airplay Submission Route
country: United States / Portland, Maine community radio
feeAmount: Free-first/manual digital airplay route. Official WMPG Music Department guidance accepts only digital MP3/WAV files via a downloadable-link email route and asks submitters to include genre(s) in the subject line.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for MP3/WAV file selection, durable download-link permissions, genre-specific subject line, metadata/one-sheet, clean/radio edit suitability, release timing and follow-up cadence. No outbound email was sent, no files were transferred and no link was delivered.
notes: Official WMPG route is active and public-authorized; queued as a manual pitch because it requires artist-controlled assets and editorial airplay review. Physical CDs are not requested for this route.

name: KALX Berkeley Physical Pressed CD LP Music Director Route
country: United States / Berkeley, California college and community radio
feeAmount: Free/manual physical music-director route. Official KALX guidance lists a Music Director contact route but only accepts physical, professionally pressed CDs or LPs for airplay consideration.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for physical pressed-CD/LP availability, postal mailing cost, one-sheet, FCC-clean/radio edit notes, genre routing and no-digital-submission compliance. No email was sent, no digital files were transferred and no physical package was prepared or mailed.
notes: Official KALX contact page explicitly rejects downloads, file transfers, Bandcamp/Spotify links, YouTube links, CD-Rs and other digital forms for music submissions, so this is queued physical/manual only.

name: CJSR Edmonton Album EP Digital Files Physical Music Department Route
feeAmount: Free-first/manual Music Department route. Official guidance accepts physical releases and digital album/EP files or cloud download links, but rejects paid streaming-only links, expiring links and singles. A separate optional local-advertising price was observed but is not required for submission.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for album/EP eligibility, no-single constraint, file/link choice, track metadata, focus tracks, language/advisory notes, artist context, customs/postal decisions if physical and optional advertising boundary separation. No email was sent, no files/links were delivered and no payment or advertising workflow was initiated.
notes: Official CJSR page is active and public-authorized for campus-community radio review; queued manual because asset selection, link durability, metadata and release-fit choices must be controlled by the artist.

name: WNCW Carolina CD WAV MP3 Programming Department Route
country: United States / North Carolina public radio
feeAmount: Free-first/manual programming route. Official WNCW guidance prefers CDs but also accepts WAV/MP3 files delivered by cloud link with a one-sheet; airplay is hand-picked and not guaranteed.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for CD versus WAV/MP3 route selection, Dropbox/Google Drive permissions, one-sheet, clean/radio edit suitability, focus tracks, release timing and expectation management. No email was sent, no files/links were delivered and no physical package was prepared or mailed.
notes: Official WNCW route accepts both singles and albums/EPs but remains editorial/manual; queued for owner-controlled pitch preparation and no automated requesting campaign.

name: WFUV New York Music Department Snail Mail Airplay Route
country: United States / New York public radio
feeAmount: Free/manual Music Department route. Official WFUV contact guidance asks artists to send music by snail mail to the Music Department at the station address and provides a narrow follow-up call window.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for physical mailer decision, one-sheet, clean/radio edit suitability, AAA/music-discovery fit, New York/public-radio positioning and follow-up timing. No email was sent, no contact form was used and no physical package was prepared or mailed.
notes: Official WFUV route is active and public-authorized, but it is a manual physical/snail-mail intake route rather than an automated submission form.
